sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can introduce an opinion with szerintem, azt hiszem, or gondolom.
I can say what I'd rather do, and which of two things I like better.
I can compare two things, pick the best, or say two things are equally good.
I can agree or disagree with someone using egyetért and nem értek egyet.
I can back up my opinion with a reason using mert or azért, mert.
